__comment: Control tower: a chunky plinth, a short wide shaft, and a cabin that only slightly overhangs.
__comment2: Every face uses the WHOLE texture rather than a slice of it. The block textures are complete framed panels - brass border around a screen - so taking a rectangle out of one yields a stripe of border or a fragment of screen, which is what made the first attempt look broken. Showing each element a whole panel reads as stacked casings instead, which is at least deliberate. Proper part-textures would be better and are the real fix.

elements.__comment: Shaft - wide enough to carry the cabin without looking like a stem
Cabin - a modest overhang, not a mushroom cap
